What I do

Clinical expertise meets operational know-how.

I help ABA providers build the foundation a compliant, well-run agency needs, so you can focus on clients.

Consulting in person and virtually, with clients served across Texas, New Jersey, Florida, Indiana, Maryland, Virginia, and Nevada.

About me

Hi, I'm Estrella Guerra, M.S., BCBA, LBA.

I'm a Board Certified Behavior Analyst and clinical leader who loves the side of ABA most people never see: the systems that make great care possible.

I've served in clinical director and assistant director roles and have helped new agencies across several states build their policies, contracts, compliance tools and launch plans from the ground up.

I started BehaviorBCBA Consulting & More to give ABA founders a partner who understands both the clinical standards and the business realities, so they can open their doors with confidence and focus on the families they serve.

Everything a new or growing agency needs to run well.

For agency owners, new clinic founders and clinical directors.
